context: M1 o5. Corwin lobby, about 21:45. Odessa waited up in her lobby chair.

lines.speaker: char.odessa_pruitt
lines.text: Mr. Arce. You're early, and you've been with a policeman. I smell the cigar.

lines.speaker: char.teddy_arce
lines.text: Old friend, Mrs. Pruitt. Why are you still up?

lines.speaker: char.odessa_pruitt
lines.text: Somebody taped a paper on the mailboxes. It says 'new management.'

lines.speaker: char.odessa_pruitt
lines.text: I came here in fifty-six. Nobody ever needed to manage me.

lines.speaker: char.teddy_arce
lines.text: I'll read it on my shift. Go up. I've got the desk.

lines.speaker: char.odessa_pruitt
lines.text: Good night, Mr. Arce. Eleven-oh-four is still mine. Write that in your book.
